notes.title: Update regarding development & Week Long Deal (50% off)
notes.notes:
Since our last news we continued the development. Here are the latest news.
We want to celebrate these news with 50% off in a Week Long Deal!

We're reporting our latest progress at our Discord server. Please visit us!

All progress presented in this news are still part of the alpha version we are currently working on. This will await you in future!

We reached following milestones:

New coat of whitewash: The entire UI gets a modern upgrade! We presented some of that last year. This time we're done with the options menu and all loading and saving options.
New outfits: Hana gets more outfits which aren't green.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25715694/4f15b9f2af7b05e949333ebcdb12452d964a9872.png

Back to life: Died? No problem. You will be able to jump back to the decision after dying. Otherwise you can load a save game.
Agony of choice: You will be able to select between 5 text speeds. No patience? Then select the infinity symbol and the text will be displayed at once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25715694/43887d16b88460a6aed334b69d8164235c503c0a.png

More slots: More save slots for everyone! We will increase the number of save slots from 5 to 10. You can delete your save games easily if you don't need them anymore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25715694/25c2437a60415248d521d606a361d67cd71b81d5.png

Misclicked? No Problem at all. At every crucial decision (loading, saving, etc) there will pop up a window for confirmation.
What's in a name: You will be able to change your player name all the time via the options menu.


At the end a small look ahead. We're currently working on these milestones:


Gallery with profiles which will change during the game.
Bonus content (available after Early access)

	
More screenshots at our Discord!

All in this news and on Discord displayed changes of the alpha version are still not available in the playable version.

notes.title: Bugfix 0.4.2
notes.notes:
Fixed Einar's gallery note at the end of the route.
Tymo's Route: On Day 12, the game jumped into German. Fixed.
Einar's Route: On day 41, the game stopped at a decision. Fixed.
Every day is now called DAY in English. ;)

Unfortunately, the skip function is anything but good, that unfortunately lies at the engine, we use. At the moment, we can not offer a solution. Since the game works with Lovemeter and can always change a scene, it is difficult to build a skip function that can skip entire scenarios.
